Privacy Policy

Pulse of the Economy is a read-only news blog. This page explains, in plain terms, what information is — and is not — collected when you visit.

We do not ask you for personal data

This blog does not ask readers for any personal information. There are no user accounts, no sign-ups, no comment forms, and no newsletter yet. You can read every story here without giving us your name, your email address, or anything else about yourself.

Analytics: Cloudflare Web Analytics

The only measurement we use is Cloudflare Web Analytics. It counts visits and shows us which pages are read the most, so we can understand what readers find useful. It is cookieless — it does not use cookies — and it does not collect data that identifies individual people.

Hosting

This site is hosted on Netlify. As with any website, the hosting provider may process basic technical information (such as IP addresses in server logs) in order to deliver the pages to your browser.

External links

Our stories and pages link out to other sites, including our Facebook Page and our account on X. Those services have their own privacy policies, which apply once you leave this site — we do not control how they handle your data.

Questions about privacy

If you have any question about this policy or about your privacy on this blog, email us at pulseoftheeconomy@gmail.com.
